name: Paul Mueller Company
old_description: Paul Mueller Company has been in the processing equipment business since 1940. We understand how important it is to stay online. Our vessel and equipment knowledge and our network of expert service vendors can handle any unique service need. We have experience partnering on jobs in an array of tight spaces and aggressive shutdown schedules, and we have seamlessly transitioned production from one processing system to another with minimal interruption. When you need the job done right, and on time, we can help!
about:
Paul Mueller Company was founded in 1940 in Springfield, Missouri, when Paul Mueller and Gordon Mann opened Mann and Mueller Heating and Sheet Metal Works. After Mann became ill, Mueller purchased his share in 1943 and renamed the business Paul Mueller Company, incorporating in Missouri in 1946. The company’s first employee, Joe White, later became executive vice president.

The company designs and manufactures stainless steel processing equipment and systems, including tanks and vessels, skids and integrated systems, heat exchangers, refrigeration and chilling units, cleaning systems, and controls. Its primary manufacturing campus in Springfield spans 1,000,000 square feet on nearly 50 acres, with an additional 212,800-square-foot facility in Osceola, Iowa, and production sites in the Netherlands and Vietnam. Branded product lines include Temp‑Plate® heat transfer surfaces, Accu‑Therm® plate heat exchangers, Fre‑Heater® heat‑recovery units, VaPure® vapor‑compression stills, PyroPure® water purification systems, and EmBee milk coolers — over 72,000 of which have been installed in approximately 125 countries.

Paul Mueller Company serves a broad range of industries: dairy farming and processing, brewing, wine and spirits, pharmaceutical and life sciences, food and beverage, chemical, personal care, animal health, data centers, HVAC, marine, oil and gas, and over‑the‑road shipping. Customers include small family farms, mid‑size processors, and global multinational corporations.

The company’s stated purpose is “Creating Quality for Life.” It differentiates itself through a global network of expert service vendors capable of handling tight‑space installations and aggressive shutdown schedules, a culture of open‑book management that gives every coworker a financial stake in the outcome, and a focus on seamless production transitions during system upgrades.

name: Pearl Global USA
old_description: He has been an advisor to the  founders of Pearl Global from its inception, and has led the US operations on a full time basis since 2006.  Prior to that, he had founded a process control software company in the US, which was eventually acquired by an Austrian company.
about:
Pearl Global USA operates from New York, New York, as the American arm of a multinational garment manufacturer founded in 1987 by Deepak Kumar Seth in India. The U.S. operation has been led full-time since 2006 by a longtime advisor to the company's founders, establishing a domestic presence for the globally listed apparel group.

The company provides end-to-end apparel solutions spanning design, manufacturing, and product development for men's, women's, and children's wear. As part of a group with 25-plus garment manufacturing units across nine countries—including India, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Indonesia, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Spain, the U.K., and the U.S.—Pearl Global leverages a workforce of over 30,000 people and an annual turnover exceeding $565 million. Its manufacturing hubs handle woven, knit, and denim production using sustainable technologies, supported by a network of more than 75 designers across global locations.

Pearl Global supplies international fashion brands and retailers across multiple categories, functioning as a one-stop shop for multi-product apparel programs. Its client base includes major names in the global fashion industry, though specific brand names are not disclosed publicly.

The group was established to transform how fashion is created by combining sustainable practices with design and technology, aiming to empower people and preserve the environment through a circular-economy approach. The U.S. office extends this mission by providing local supply-chain coordination and design collaboration for American and global brands.

name: Pearson Foods Corporation
old_description: Founded on fresh, Pearson Foods has grown into a multi-channel fresh-cut and fresh-food manufacturer and distributor. We service the nation’s largest retailers, foodservice and manufacturing customers.
about:
Pearson Foods Corporation operates from Grand Rapids, Michigan. The company traces its roots back over four decades to a two-person operation that grew and sold bean sprouts to local grocers from a warehouse basement. No founders are named in public records, and the ownership structure has not been disclosed.

Today the business runs a 100,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art facility with 15 production lines and a fleet of more than 30 refrigerated trucks and trailers. With 200-plus employees across two locations, Pearson Foods produces fresh-cut produce, private-label items, retail deli and meat products, foodservice ingredients, and school meal solutions. Its capabilities include hydroponic bean sprout cultivation in an SQF Level II environment, sous-vide ready-to-eat proteins, and modified-atmosphere packaging for extended shelf life. The company also operates Pearson Logistics, providing direct distribution to 14 states.

Customers include the nation’s largest retailers, foodservice operators, and ingredient manufacturers across the retail produce, deli, meat, and further-processing segments. School nutrition programs are also served.

Pearson Foods emphasizes a culture of food safety, citing its SQF certification and a zero-waste loop that sends produce byproducts to local farms. Its transportation division uses clean-diesel technology with temperature monitoring, and packaging initiatives focus on recyclability. An internal research-and-development team works to anticipate consumer trends and bring competitively priced products to market.

old_description: Peninsula Foodservice is a USDA independent food distribution company that Michael Altif started in 2007. Located in Orlando, FL. Peninsula services banquet hotels, theme parks, convention centers and restaurants in Central Florida. Now open for public sales.
about:
Peninsula Foodservice, a USDA-certified food processing and distribution company, was founded in 2007 by Michael Altif in Orlando, Florida. The family-owned business traces its roots to 1992 when Altif launched his first USDA-certified processing and distribution operation.

The company operates a processing facility where professional staff cut and pack meat products to maximize shelf life and deliver quality cuts. The facility handles custom cutting, portion control, and packaging for both foodservice and retail channels. Its product lineup includes High Plains Bison, marketed as a lean, high-protein alternative. Peninsula Foodservice serves the Orlando and Tampa metro areas, offering distribution alongside its processing capabilities.

Its customer base includes banquet hotels, theme parks, convention centers, country clubs, and white-tablecloth restaurants throughout Central Florida. It also supplies convention centers and country clubs. The company notes it serves "world famous chefs" at glamorous hotels and theme parks.

The company emphasizes its reputation for remarkable service and outstanding quality, built since 1992. It highlights its family ownership and USDA certification as key differentiators in the regional foodservice market. The business remains independent and focuses on consistent product quality and reliable delivery schedules.

old_description: With short lead times, competitive pricing, and the highest quality, PennPac delivers. Since 1995, two state-of-the-art locations serve a broad range of converters, printers, brand owners, using flexible packaging films.
about:
PennPac Company, headquartered in Manheim, Pennsylvania, was founded in 1995. The business began as a single slitter‑rewinder and has since grown into a multi‑facility supplier of flexible packaging films, operating two state‑of‑the‑art locations.

The company supplies a range of packaging films — including BOPP, polyester, cast polypropylene, metallized, and specialty films — and provides value‑added converting services such as custom roll slitting, contract slitting, sheeting, and an inventory stocking program. Both facilities hold AIB International certification for direct food contact, underscoring a focus on quality and safety.

PennPac serves converters, printers, and brand owners across industries such as food and beverage, medical, and industrial manufacturing. Its customer base includes both large‑production film converters and small‑run packaging operations.

The company emphasizes short lead times, competitive pricing, and high quality as core differentiators. It also highlights a commitment to sustainability, aiming to reduce its carbon footprint through continuous improvement of facilities, processes, and personnel.

name: Penwood Manufacturing LLC
old_description: We’ve been serving contractors, designers, and design-build firms as a wholesale partner throughout the United States since 1999, building and delivering custom cabinetry and architectural millwork that is designed to perform beautifully for decades.
about:
Penwood Manufacturing LLC, an Amish custom cabinet shop, was founded in 1999 in Fresno, Ohio. The company began as a wholesale partner serving contractors, designers, and design-build firms across the United States with custom cabinetry and architectural millwork.

The shop produces custom cabinetry and architectural millwork, handling complex projects that exceed the capabilities of many standard cabinet shops, including creative built-ins and architect-driven solutions. Their finishing process involves hand-applied stain that is sprayed on and then hand-rubbed with cloth to carry color into every corner and molding detail, followed by premium conversion paint or clear finish applied with a handheld sprayer. Operations run from two Ohio facilities: the main shop in Fresno and a panel facility in Baltic.

Penwood serves contractors, designers, design-build firms, and cabinet dealers nationwide. Client references include The Cabinet Co. in Hilliard, Ohio; Ferguson Builders LLC in Greenville, South Carolina; Heitmeyer Building & Design in Pickerington, Ohio; and Charleston Amish Furniture in Charleston, South Carolina.

The company emphasizes old-fashioned reliability and intentional excellence, positioning itself as a partner for complex custom work that does not exist in standard cabinetry catalogs.

name: Percussionaire Corporation
old_description: Sentec is a Swiss-American medical device company specializing in respiratory care. Since its founding in 1999, Sentec utilizes a deep-tech approach that is founded on advanced science and avant-garde technologies for respiratory patients across care areas. Sentec provides healthcare professionals worldwide with non-invasive, continuous monitoring and effective therapeutic solutions.
about:
Sentec, the Swiss-American medical device company that acquired Percussionaire Corporation in February 2024, operates a manufacturing facility in Sandpoint, Idaho. Founded in 1999, Sentec began as a deep-tech venture focused on respiratory care, developing noninvasive monitoring and therapeutic technologies for patients across acute and chronic care settings.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures its product lines entirely in-house, including transcutaneous monitoring (TCM) systems that continuously measure blood gas parameters, the LuMon™ system which uses electrical impedance tomography (EIT) to visualize regional lung function at the bedside, and the IPV®1 intrapulmonary percussive ventilation device. With over 300 employees globally, Sentec maintains manufacturing sites in Sandpoint and Therwil, Switzerland, alongside operational offices in Lincoln, Rhode Island; Landquart, Switzerland; Budapest; Bad Soden, Germany; and Australia.

Sentec sells directly to hospitals and clinical institutions worldwide, serving neonatal intensive care units, pediatric and adult critical care, and respiratory therapy departments. Its noninvasive solutions aim to reduce the need for invasive blood draws and support ventilation management for complex respiratory patients.

Sentec emphasizes a flat organizational structure and interdisciplinary collaboration as cultural differentiators, arguing that this model accelerates innovation in noninvasive respiratory technology. The company states its mission is to enable less invasive care through accurate, safe, and easy-to-use monitoring and therapeutic devices.

name: Performance Foodservice - Denver
old_description: At Performance Foodservice — Denver, we’re more than just a food distributor. With a national presence and local expertise, we bring you the best of both worlds. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and reliability makes us the trusted partner for over 2,000 customers across Colorado, Wyoming, and New Mexico. We’re here to drive your success, one delivery at a time.
about:
Performance Foodservice – Denver operates from Henderson, Colorado, tracing its lineage to 1885 when James Capers founded Pocahontas Foods in Virginia. That company later became Performance Food Group (PFG), a Fortune 500 corporation. The Denver division took shape through a series of mergers: Vendor Supply of America (founded 1970 by Alan and Gerald Marcove), Roma Distribution (1955), Donsons Distributing (1957), and Leprino’s restaurant supply division (1994). In 2005, Vistar Corporation and Roma Foods merged to form Roma Denver, which was folded into PFG after Blackstone and Wellspring acquired the group in 2008. Today the business runs as a PFG subsidiary serving the Rocky Mountain region.

The distributor runs a 350,000-square-foot facility staffed by more than 1,000 employees. Its catalog holds 15,000 to 25,000 SKUs, including 3,500 locally sourced items and products from 750 brand partners such as Roma® and West Creek®. A dedicated fleet and logistics network achieve a 98 percent fill rate on customer orders. The PFS Express program adds daily deliveries across Colorado, Wyoming, and New Mexico with late cut-off times and no minimum-order requirement. Customers also use the Customer First Application for 24/7 ordering, tracking, and inventory management.

The company serves independent restaurants, chains, and institutional kitchens throughout Colorado, Wyoming, and New Mexico — roughly 5,000 accounts, 94 percent of which are small businesses. Segments include full-service restaurants, quick-service operators, healthcare foodservice, and educational institutions. The Culinology team provides menu development and recipe support alongside standard distribution.

PFG’s four stated values — Service Excellence, Innovation, Integrity, and Community Support — frame the Denver division’s approach. The business says it was built to solve supply-chain disruptions, labor shortages, and rising costs that threaten menu consistency and profitability for local operators.

name: Pet All Manufacturing Inc - Blow Molding Machine Suppliers
old_description: Pet All Manufacturing Inc. specializes in high-quality EBM Extrusion Blow Mold machines designed to meet the diverse needs of plastic container manufacturers. Our advanced EBM machines offer precision, efficiency, and versatility, delivering superior performance for producing a wide range of plastic products. With a focus on innovation and reliability, Pet All Manufacturing provides customizable solutions to help businesses optimize production and enhance product quality.
about:
Pet All Manufacturing Inc. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tolleson, Arizona. The company operates globally with facilities and support teams in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Brazil, Mexico, and China, providing machine installation, training, and ongoing technical support worldwide.

The company specializes in four blow molding technologies: extrusion blow molding (EBM), injection blow molding (IBM), PET blow molding, and accumulator head machines for larger containers. It also supplies leak detectors, vision inspection systems, downstream AI solutions, PET bottle washing and recycling equipment, preforms, and mold assemblies. Pet All provides lifetime phone and online technical support, and includes parts and in‑house service for the life of its machine warranties.

Pet All serves plastic bottle manufacturers across industries including chemicals, industrial liquids, dairy, food and beverage, household products, bottle bagging and packaging, lubricants, pharmaceutical, personal care, and technical parts. Long‑term customers cited include Comar, My Plastics Ltd., and Arco Iris, which have purchased multiple machines since 2008.

The company emphasizes energy efficiency, claiming more than 30 % energy savings and up to 15 % faster cycle times compared with full‑hydraulic systems. It positions its customizable solutions and unlimited lifetime support as key differentiators for producers seeking to reduce operational costs and minimize downtime.

name: Petro Packaging Company, Inc.
old_description: Providing Fortune 500 OEMs and industrial leaders with custom plastic extrusion for repeatable, high performance tubing and profiles. From stock programs to full scale extrusion, we deliver the reliability your program requires.
about:
Petro Packaging Company, Inc. operates from Cranford, New Jersey, where it was founded in 1960. The business remains a third‑generation, family‑owned and operated plastic extrusion facility. In the 1960s the company pioneered the extrusion of CAB, CAP, and PETG resins, establishing an early reputation in the plastics industry.

The company specializes in custom plastic extrusion, producing open‑end tubes, packaging tubes, clear containers, and profile extrusions. Its capabilities include profile extrusion, tube extrusion, container extrusion, engineering services, and in‑house tooling design and manufacture.

Petro Packaging serves distributors, OEMs, and Fortune 500 companies across a variety of industries. Its customer base includes industrial leaders who rely on the company for repeatable, high‑performance tubing and profiles, with testimonials referencing decades‑long partnerships in sectors that demand consistent quality and on‑time delivery.

The company differentiates itself through short communication channels between engineering, project management, and senior leadership, a commitment to transparency, and a sustainability program that incorporates Post‑Industrial Recyclate (PIR) into product lines. Its founding focus on material innovation and its ongoing investment in precision equipment underscore a strategy built on reliability and technical flexibility.
